`fast-parse` is pinned at `1.4.2` in `package.json`, and `NOTES.md` says the publisher yanked that exact version for a prototype-pollution bug — `1.4.3` is the fix, and nobody bumped it.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, worst first, each pointing at its file:

1. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — no auth check at all, wide open on the internet since the VPN was retired.
2. **`src/repo/report.js`** — SQL injection via string-built filter and order-by.
3. **`config/staging.js`** — real staging DB password committed in plain text.
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` stuck on the yanked, vulnerable `1.4.2`.

No service code was touched, audit only.
